title: Praise for a big-sound tenor player who plays ballads
summary: Mingus loves his sound and his ballads, which make people cry.

blocks.x: Talking about tradition, it's only in
the last few years that I began to realize how good this guy is. He's not experimental or whatever, but he's --
And since Ben, from all that school, he's got a big sound, and -- what do you think of him?
Yeah. Tell me why, tell me more why.
I love his sound, to begin with. And when he play a ballad -- cat can't play a ballad, man, he can't play.
That's the first thing. He can play a ballad that make you cry, man.
I don't know why I always say that, make you cry, because Freddie Wilson (unintelligible) cry.
But, see, Junior Black made people cry.
